why_octoeye.octopus_eyes: Octopus eyes evolved INDEPENDENTLY from vertebrate eyes. They have no blind spot. The retina faces FORWARD.
why_octoeye.sporegate_is_sealed: sporeGate has 0 open ports — it ONLY pulls data IN. Like a retina — it only receives light.
why_octoeye.frame_is_the_lens: Frame has 26 cameras, XR, IR proximity, 3D Hall sensor, thermometers. It's a multi-spectrum lens.
why_octoeye.usb_is_optic_nerve: The USB cable carries signals from lens to brain. Direct, fast, physical.
why_octoeye.result: sporeGate + Frame = a complete eye: lens → nerve → processing brain → perception
